name: dfhl-blitz
description: DFHL Blitz - online 3-on-3 arcade hockey for the DFHL fantasy league

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dfhl/client && npm run build -w @dfhl/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json --noEmit
